subject: 5F8F9C8FC270E02F85790BAA9EAE1BDE
introduction: These are fragments of memory, Bahá’u’lláh’s and ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s, about the years before the mission was announced: a minister’s son who wanted no office, a youth astonished by the idle questions of turbaned divines, quiet fasts and secluded summers, then the Báb’s cause taken up, prison at Ámul, a house plundered and a child given flour to eat from his palm, and through it a prayer for concord among all on earth. The patterns are old ones. Moses refuses the court; a boy astonishes the teachers; Amos is told to prophesy somewhere else; a kingdom is offered and declined; the house on earth is lost and another is spoken of; the widow has a handful of meal. Kant’s starry heavens and the psalm on princes stand beside two small moments, a dawn and a death, that the memories preserve.
questions: Moses “refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter”. What do readings 1 and 17 suggest about why rank was declined, and what it left him free for?
The learned in readings 3 and 4 debate the rank of Gabriel. What does the young listener’s reaction tell us about the kind of knowledge he valued?
A plundered house, and a mansion “in the Kingdom”. How do readings 18 and 19 hold real loss together with that consolation?
The guide ends with a prayer for unity among all on earth. How do the earlier memories prepare for it?

outside.why: A child of a minister’s family with “no desire whatsoever for rank and position”. Moses, come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
All were amazed at the child’s intelligence. All that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
“This Servant was not among the learned ones.” How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
Amos disclaims the schools as well: I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman.
Divines debate whether Gabriel ranks above a servant of ‘Alí. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
The discourse of the learned culminated in an idle question. They shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
He kept a quiet fast on the eve of ‘Áshúrá. When thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face; that thou appear not unto men to fast.
People who profess that “the believer is the brother of the believer” do not act on it. He that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
He chose a secluded place. Rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
Chieftains who had come to esteem him in the mountains sought his presence in Baghdad. The queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon and came to prove him.
When the Báb declared himself, he began to spread the Báb’s cause. Whom shall I send? Here am I; send me.
Imprisoned at Ámul after teaching day and night. They departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
He set out to join the besieged at Tabarsí. Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
The chief minister politely suggests that he leave the capital. The priest of Bethel to Amos: O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah; but prophesy not again any more at Bethel.
The government wished to grant him a district as a fief, and the offer lapsed when he answered another call. The tempter on the mountain: all these things will I give thee.
His mansion was seized and destroyed, “yet His Mansion in the Kingdom was adorned”. If our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands.
Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where thieves break through and steal: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven.
Everything plundered overnight; a mother pours a little flour into a child’s palm. The widow of Zarephath has an handful of meal in a barrel and a little oil in a cruse.

Awake before sunrise, “admiring with wonder this infinite universe of God”. Kant: two things fill the mind with ever new and increasing admiration and awe, the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me.
An order to seize him lapsed when the Shah died. Put not your trust in princes: his breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
He asked God for “that which was the cause of love, fellowship and unity among all who are on earth”. That they all may be one.

shortfall: Several readings are recollections of places, dates and journeys that were left to stand by themselves.
